_about: The library of bricks a group composes its robot's personality from. Two kinds, marked as such: "pilot" bricks are settings of the Pilot, held by its code and always applied; "strategist" bricks are instructions in the Strategist's system message, which the model follows often but can forget. A group finds out at the simulator which ones always hold. No brick can loosen the Referee's rules. The texts come from the cards of the bench of 6 November 2026 (facilitator/workshops/measures/2026-11-06-robot-architectures/personas/).

long_legs.means: the Pilot goes up to 4 cells in one move

short_legs.means: the Pilot goes 2 cells at most in one move

pilot_waits_for_balls.means: before each leg, the Pilot waits while a ball seen just before comes closer

pilot_never_waits_for_balls.means: the Pilot never waits for a ball (the Referee still refuses what is unsafe)

pilot_looks_each_leg.means: the Pilot looks around before every leg

cross_when_boxed.means: boxed in, with a ball's lane as the only way out, the Pilot crosses it (the Referee still refuses while the ball is near)

go_far.text: Go far in one go: when you have an idea where to go, go there at once with `go_to_cell`.

look_only_when_lost.text: Do not look around again before moving if you already know enough. Look around only when you have no idea where to go.

dont_wait_for_balls.text: Do not wait for balls: the robot protects itself.

look_before_each_route.text: Never move without having looked just before: call `look_around` before every `go_to_cell`.

wait_for_balls.text: When a ball was seen coming closer, wait (`wait_for_event`) and look again, until you see it moving away. Only then go.
